data.name: NotesDesc
data.value: Item notes, usually left blank, does not affect gameplay

data.name: RangeDesc
data.value: Attack range, 1 for melee, varies for ranged weapons

data.name: ChargeProfilesDesc
data.value: Content/ammo ID code, used with chargeprofiles data, may be comma-separated like '6,31'

data.name: SoundDesc
data.value: Weapon sound category: Melee/Punch, Claws, Club, Blade, Rifle, Pistol, Laser, Bow, Throw, Choke, Grasp, Bite

data.name: TransferDesc
data.value: Transfer property: Whether attack can be converted to item, e.g., bow arrows can be recovered. 0 no transfer, 1 transfer (arrows, slingshot ammo stays on enemy or drops)

data.name: AttackerConditionsDesc
data.value: Conditions during attack, used with conditions data, e.g., '211x1.0,NSE:42x1'

data.name: ImageDesc
data.value: Weapon icon filename in lower right corner

data.name: MoraleDesc
data.value: Default morale bonus from this weapon, formula: (1+morale)*(1+melee/ranged morale bonus)*weapon damage=actual damage

data.name: WieldPhraseDesc
data.value: Text description when entering combat with this weapon

data.name: AttackPhrasesDesc
data.value: Text description when attacking with this weapon, multiple descriptions separated by commas

data.name: BuysDesc
data.value: Whether player items can be purchased: 0 no, 1 yes

data.name: RestockTreasureIdDesc
data.value: Referenced treasure data, used with treasuretable. Note: Detroit C shop is an exception, uses treasure pool 3

data.name: SuccessDesc
data.value: Text displayed in game after action succeeds, <us> represents self, <them> represents target

data.name: FailDesc
data.value: Text displayed in game after action fails

data.name: PopUpDesc
data.value: Action description in game, shown in action selection screen

data.name: UsConditionsDesc
data.value: Required conditions for our side, minus sign means NOT, i.e., not in that state

data.name: ThemConditionsDesc
data.value: Required conditions for opponent, minus sign means NOT, i.e., not in that state

data.name: PairConditionsDesc
data.value: Effect this action brings to self

data.name: UsFailConditionsDesc
data.value: Conditions brought to self when action fails

data.name: ThemFailConditionsDesc
data.value: Conditions brought to opponent when action fails (all official data is empty)

data.name: PairFailConditionsDesc
data.value: Effect brought to self when action fails

data.name: UsPreConditionsDesc
data.value: Prerequisites for executing this action, format like '137,151,-143' (negative means cannot have that condition)

data.name: SeeThemDesc
data.value: Exposure level opponent needs to be at

data.name: SeeUsDesc
data.value: Exposure level self needs to be at

data.name: AllOutOfRangeDesc
data.value: Distance from all targets on field

data.name: InAttackRangeDesc
data.value: Attack range, possibly used to determine splash or weapon length

data.name: MinRangeDesc
data.value: Minimum range requirement, -1 for full field coverage

data.name: MaxRangeDesc
data.value: Maximum range requirement, -1 for full field coverage

data.name: AttackModeTypeDesc
data.value: Attack mode type: -1 non-attack action, 0 melee attack, 1 ranged attack

data.name: HexTypesDesc
data.value: Map hex type (all official data is empty)

data.name: PriorityDesc
data.value: Priority, no effect on player, Bot only, which side's action triggers first in same turn

data.name: DetectDesc
data.value: Chance of being detected when executing this action, 0 means won't be detected

data.name: ApproachDesc
data.value: Whether this action makes you approach opponent

data.name: OffenseDesc
data.value: Whether this is an offensive action

data.name: FallBackDesc
data.value: Whether this action is a retreat action

data.name: RetreatDesc
data.value: Whether this action is a retreat action

data.name: PositionDesc
data.value: Whether this action is a position action

data.name: DescriptionDesc
data.value: Camp description, e.g., 'Dark area of the region'

data.name: TreasureIdDesc
data.value: Treasure pool ID for this camp

data.name: VisibilityDesc
data.value: Default visibility value of camp (percentage), -0.05 means -5%

data.name: HealPerHourModDesc
data.value: Default recovery effect per hour from camp (percentage)

data.name: SleepQualityDesc
data.value: Default sleep quality from camp (percentage), -0.26 means -26%

data.name: PerHourDesc
data.value: Amount consumed per hour, mainly for electrical power consumption

data.name: PerHourEquippedDesc
data.value: Durability consumed per hour when equipped, only for XM54 filter chip

data.name: FieldNamesDesc
data.value: Effect field list brought by this condition, e.g., 'm_fHealPerHourMod,m_fImmuneRestoreRate'

data.name: ModifiersDesc
data.value: Specific effect values brought by this condition, corresponding to FieldNames

data.name: EffectsDesc
data.value: Effects brought by condition, e.g., SetImmunity, ArmorWound. Like 'ArmorWound=100,0.1,0.05'

data.name: FatalDesc
data.value: Whether it brings death effect to player (will getting this condition kill you)

data.name: IdNextDesc
data.value: Next stage condition ID this condition brings, may be multiple comma-separated

data.name: PermanentDesc
data.value: Whether it brings long-term effects (like medicine, cuts, etc.), true means won't auto-remove after turn ends

data.name: ChanceNextDesc
data.value: Chance of this condition bringing new condition in next stage

data.name: DisplayOtherDesc
data.value: Whether this condition can be seen by others

data.name: DisplayGameOverDesc
data.value: Whether this condition appears in game over summary

data.name: ColorDesc
data.value: Condition color: 0 white, 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow

data.name: ResetTimerDesc
data.value: Refresh time, one rest in game equals one hour

data.name: ThresholdsDesc
data.value: Trigger threshold, currently used for legendary skill triggers

data.name: EncounterIdsDesc
data.value: List of condition IDs triggered when encountering this creature, comma-separated

data.name: AttackModesDesc
data.value: Attack mode ID, used with attackmodes, may be single ID or comma-separated

data.name: BaseConditionsDesc
data.value: Base conditions when creature spawns, format like '38=1,50=0.5'

data.name: ActivitiesDesc
data.value: Description of creature's activity pattern, possibly for notes only

data.name: CreatureIdDesc
data.value: Spawned creature ID, used with creatures table

data.name: MaxDesc
data.value: Maximum spawn count (too large value causes many creatures to spawn in same hex)

data.name: EncounterIdDesc
data.value: Called encounter ID, used with encounters

data.name: RemoveTreasureIdDesc
data.value: Treasure pool ID removed at player's feet when encounter occurs

data.name: ConditionsDesc
data.value: List of attached condition IDs for this encounter, comma-separated

data.name: PreConditionsDesc
data.value: Required preconditions for this encounter, negative means cannot have that condition

data.name: PriceDesc
data.value: Whether this encounter changes your assets

data.name: ResponsesDesc
data.value: Player response options during encounter, format like '=15x0.083x0x0x0,=16x0.083x0x0x0'

data.name: RemoveCreaturesDesc
data.value: Whether creatures need to be removed when this encounter occurs

data.name: RemoveUsedDesc
data.value: Whether this encounter removes your items

data.name: ItemsIdDesc
data.value: Item ID generated when this encounter occurs

data.name: CreatureHexDesc
data.value: Creature spawn position coordinates, format like '0,0'

data.name: TeleportDesc
data.value: Position player is teleported to when this encounter occurs, '0,0' for no teleport

data.name: AccidentChanceDesc
data.value: Chance of accident occurring (e.g., building collapse)

data.name: AccidentsDesc
data.value: Event ID when accident occurs (calls encounters)

data.name: LootDesc
data.value: Treasure type ID when scavenging succeeds

data.name: AIPassableDesc
data.value: Whether this event can be triggered by AI

data.name: AreaDesc
data.value: Position coordinates where this event triggers, format like '20,164,0'

data.name: DictFactionsDesc
data.value: Reputation relationship with other factions, format like '0=-100,1=1,2=-100'

data.name: TerrainCostDesc
data.value: Action points consumed on this hex

data.name: PassableDesc
data.value: Whether can move to this terrain: 0 impassable, 1 passable

data.name: ScavengeInitialIdDesc
data.value: Treasure pool ID used when first scavenging this terrain

data.name: ScavengeItemsIdPerHourDesc
data.value: Treasure pool ID used when scavenging this terrain repeatedly

data.name: LightLevelsDesc
data.value: Light levels, corresponding to: dawn, morning, noon, afternoon, dusk, midnight, 6 floats

data.name: DefaultCampIdDesc
data.value: Default camp ID code, used with treasuretable

data.name: ConditionIdsDesc
data.value: Condition IDs brought to player when entering this hex

data.name: RequiredPropsDesc
data.value: Required property IDs for this ingredient, '&' can be used for AND relationship

data.name: ForbidPropsDesc
data.value: Property IDs this ingredient cannot have

data.name: EquipConditionsDesc
data.value: Conditions brought to you when this item is equipped

data.name: PossessConditionsDesc
data.value: Permanent conditions brought to you when holding this item

data.name: UseConditionsDesc
data.value: Conditions brought to you when using this item

data.name: EquipSlotsDesc
data.value: Equipment slots, positions item can be placed on body: 20 left hand, 21 right hand, 22 back

data.name: UseSlotsDesc
data.value: Use position, 211 for direct self-use (like taking medicine)

data.name: SocketLockedDesc
data.value: Lock property, items with this property cannot be moved by player

data.name: PropertiesDesc
data.value: List of property IDs for this item, used for crafting and checks

data.name: ContentIdsDesc
data.value: Space property of this item, defines what items can be stored as container

data.name: FormatIdDesc
data.value: Internal treasure pool ID of this item

data.name: ComponentIdDesc
data.value: Component ID, used with treasuretable, for reverse-craftable items, items obtained by disassembling if acquired by non-crafting means

data.name: SlotDepthDesc
data.value: Determines which clothing is on top when wearing multiple items

data.name: SwitchIdsDesc
data.value: Switch ID, used for electronic device on/off state switching

data.name: SoundsDesc
data.value: Sound when picking up or putting down this item

data.name: DefinitionDesc
data.value: Map definition data, terrain data composed of large amounts of numbers and commas

data.name: SecretNameDesc
data.value: Recipe's hidden name, used to distinguish human meat from animal meat, water toxicity, etc.

data.name: ToolsDesc
data.value: Tools required for crafting, format like '1x1'

data.name: ConsumedDesc
data.value: Items that will be consumed/degraded in crafting, format like '1x2+1x3'

data.name: DestroyedDesc
data.value: Destroyed items, used for extinguishing torches, etc.

data.name: ReverseDesc
data.value: Whether reverse engineering is possible: 0 irreversible, 1 reversible, 2, etc.

data.name: HiddenIdDesc
data.value: Whether it's a hidden recipe, needs to pick up paper to unlock

data.name: IdentifyDesc
data.value: Whether it can be identified, used with hidden name

data.name: AlsoTryDesc
data.value: Other recipe IDs with different recipes but same result

data.name: TempTreasureIdDesc
data.value: Crafting result ID shown as ghost in result slot during crafting

data.name: DegradeOutputDesc
data.value: Whether crafted item durability is related to material durability: 1 related, 0 unrelated

data.name: TreasuresDesc
data.value: Treasure pool content, format 'item IDxquantityxchance', pipe | means OR, comma , means AND

data.name: NestedDesc
data.value: Whether generated items will be placed in simultaneously generated containers

data.name: SuppressDesc
data.value: Suppress content generation from items: when 1, water bottles won't have water, guns won't have bullets
